summary: Black Desert entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Black Desert
entries.definitive_edition: Current Black Desert PC client with region/account/server/version documented

emulation.notes: Online native client; service state controls access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official PC client with exact account/region/server state documented

primary.version: Current Black Desert live PC client
primary.why: Black Desert is an evolving MMORPG, so current archive capture depends on region, account/server, launcher versus Steam route, season/server rules, class, progression, monetization, and active events. Mobile and console versions are separate platform ecosystems.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official PC client. Record region, launcher/Steam route, client version, account/server, class, season/channel, graphics/remastered mode, UI, controller, Pearl Shop/monetization visibility, event state, and whether Mobile/Console were excluded.

secondary.why: They are not interchangeable with the PC MMORPG client.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Black Desert Mobile, Black Desert Console, or Crimson Desert.
